rows.title: PO header Validity Start/End for document type SBP: root cause in field selection
rows.objects: ME_PROCESS_PO_CUST (BAdI), NBF (field selection key), ZBRD (field selection key)
rows.requirement: The PO header fields Validity Start and Validity End (EKKO-KDATB, KDATE) must be input-ready for PO document type SBP only, in SAP GUI and Fiori, with no validation.
rows.challenge: The field status is the most restrictive of the merged field-selection keys. The BAdI method FIELDSELECTION_HEADER receives only customer metafields, not the standard metafields 37 and 38, so it cannot show or hide these fields.
rows.ai: Drafted a FIELDSELECTION_HEADER body, then proved from the debugger findings that the BAdI cannot reach the standard metafields. Traced the cause to OMF4 key NBF (no option ticked, T161 maps SBP to NBF), recommended a customizing-only fix and drafted the mail to the functional consultant.
rows.manual: The consultant supplied the existing method body, checked type group MMMFD, debugged FIELDSELECTION_HEADER and checked OMF4 and T161. The customizing change is made by the functional consultant.
rows.rework: 12/10/26: first delivered method assumed metafield constants MMMFD_VALIDITY_START / MMMFD_VALIDITY_END (marked ASSUMPTION; git 0a4cc83) - corrected to mmmfd_valid_from / mmmfd_valid_to (037/038) after the type group was checked (git df2eb5b) | 12/10/26: BAdI approach withdrawn - the debugger showed the method never receives standard metafields 37/38;
rows.quality: Recommendation delivered: tick Opt. entry for both fields in NBF, with no ABAP change. This avoids a BAdI that could not work and leaves other developers' customer metafields untouched.
